question: How does one become an exhaler?
premises: One should release air by piṅgalā.
The internal air makes one an exhaler.
inference: Releasing internal air through piṅgalā makes one an exhaler.
uncertainties: antaḥsthaṃ may modify vāyum as neuter.
plain_english: One should release the internal air by piṅgalā, and becomes an exhaler.
